items: Iran: the policy line, the decider line, the Pentagon role and stance, the motives decision and the pending line now record the unannounced US "defensive" strikes near Qeshm Island (Nov 2-3) and Iran's published conditions, replacing "terms unpublished".
Iran: the Sylvia leak entry and pending line updated with the internal Pentagon report (four failed polygraphs, DOJ investigating).
Venezuela: the pending line, the Treasury stance and Treasury's record now include Bessent's Nov 2 meeting with Foreign Minister Oliver Blanco on a three-phase plan.
Russia: the pending line adds the Nov 2 Russian strike on an aid hub in Zaporizhzhia.

Midterms: the pending line, the Maximalists' stance, motives and faction record now show the Supreme Court's Nov 2 denial of DOJ's request to set aside about 20,000 California ballots, the dismissal of the complaint against ex-FBI officials Floris and Benavides, and DOJ's 63 election-crime charges.
Tariffs: the pending line adds USTR's move to suspend South Africa and Rwanda from the AGOA duty-free program; Home world card added.

People added: Oliver Blanco, Zia Faruqui; updated: Trump, Bessent, Brett Sylvia, Musk, Greer, Floris, Benavides, Gleason. Donors updated: GEO Group, Senate Leadership Fund. Legal: Floris-Benavides complaint added; Sylvia and Peltola entries updated.

At the reviewer's direction the populist faction was dissolved: Carlson and Kent moved to the Vance Lane; Bannon, Loomer, Bovino, Morgan, Howell and Prince to the Maximalists; Hawley to the Party Machine; Greene to the Article I Dissenters as an outside wing; Gabbard to no faction. Its event tags, stances, motives, relationship edges and stakes were reassigned, and the page now shows ten factions.

All ten factions were rewritten on a two-layer model: a worldview stated in its own best terms, then the interests (patrons, holdings, contracts, careers) that sustain it, where members' acts depart from their words, and a historical precedent. Member rows, money rows, stances and motives were revised to match, with new sourced donor entries (among them Founders Fund, Lockheed Martin, RTX, Protect Freedom PAC, Rockbridge Network, Rebekah Mercer, Real America's Voice, Dar Global, Qatari Diar).

Corrections: Gabbard resigned citing her husband's illness, not the war; Loomer and Bannon back the Iran war; Hawley voted against Iran war powers; Bannon's and Loomer's Mercer funding links were removed (the Mercers cut Bannon off in 2017-18); Lutnick's home faction is Deal-Capital; Musk's money to the Senate Leadership Fund is $158M, not $10M.
